summary: Linux 1.0.61: the F4HWN module (imports wx) cannot load, and an image saved by it ('UV-K1 & UV-K5 V3 (F4HWN)', 0xB190 bytes, f4hwn.chirp.v6.3.0.py sha256 a307886d...) was rejected as 'Unsupported model'. Same layout as the built-in profile, which was built from that module.
title: Image from F4HWN's CHIRP module refused as unsupported model
